name: awl
description: A local workspace for computer use that learns.

scripts.build: npm run build:electron && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src electron scripts index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/office-motion-check.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/overview-smoke.mjs && node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:tools: npm run build:electron && node scripts/tools-check.mjs && node scripts/capability-check.mjs && node scripts/agent-check.mjs && node scripts/tools-browser-check.mjs
scripts.test:all: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/office-motion-check.mjs && node scripts/tools-check.mjs && node scripts/capability-check.mjs && node scripts/agent-check.mjs && node scripts/tools-browser-check.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/overview-smoke.mjs && node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs
